name: 15202 · Pittsburgh, PA
findings: ZIP 15202 (Pittsburgh) has 75 nonprofit organizations. 47 of them (63%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 37 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 15202 (Pittsburgh) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
